# GitHub Actions Status Badges

Add these badges to your main README.md to show build status:

## Build Status
```markdown
![Build Status](https://github.com/frc2053/Robot2026/workflows/Build%20Robot%20Code/badge.svg)
```

## Individual Linting Status
```markdown
![Spotless](https://github.com/frc2053/Robot2026/workflows/Build%20Robot%20Code/badge.svg?event=push&job=spotless)
![Checkstyle](https://github.com/frc2053/Robot2026/workflows/Build%20Robot%20Code/badge.svg?event=push&job=checkstyle)
![PMD](https://github.com/frc2053/Robot2026/workflows/Build%20Robot%20Code/badge.svg?event=push&job=pmd)
```
